title: Width + batch-size stack
description: Changed TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 2**19 to 2**18 on top of the ASPECT_RATIO=96 baseline (DEPTH=8 unchanged), doubling optimizer steps in the fixed 5-min budget while keeping the wider model.
reflection: The two round-0 wins do stack additively: val_bpb 0.982573, better than either alone (width-only 0.998671, batch-only-at-old-width 1.001440) and better than their naive product would suggest. This is the combo that 6/6 proposals called for across two rounds but nobody actually ran until now -- worth flagging clearly in the log so it doesn't happen a third time. Next natural step: now that we know width and step-count both help and stack, worth trying whether pushing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE down further (2^17) also helps at this width, or whether we're near a step-count optimum.
